name: case-study-builder
description: Create customer case studies in sales-ready format — Challenge→Solution→Results structure, before/after metrics, quote integration, two-length formats (1-page summary + full version). Use when creating case studies, customer success stories, proof content, or sales collateral. Triggers on: "case study", "customer story", "success story", "proof content", "customer example", "results story", or any request to document customer outcomes.
